chapter: New Orleans bands, Louis and the Lyric
title: Tom's Road House, a fight over food and Bootsy Hernandez
summary: Zutty replaced Little Joe Lindsey at Tom's Road House with Big Eye Louis, but was fired over a scuffle with the head waiter about food. Bootsy Hernandez then offered him a job at Archie's Cabaret.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well we'll think of that cats name but we have to go back now Zutto to after you had done the chauffeuring. He says, you replaced Joe Lindsey in Tom's Road House band, is that right?
He replaced Little Joe Lindsey in Tom's Road House band.
Well that was nice. That was with Big Eye Louis and Walter Decou and that gang.

But I got fired for fighting, the head waiter. You see, because old man Bouchelle that was his name, he owned the Half Way House and owned another place in New Orleans. And he left word for this head waiter to give us what we wanted to eat. And this head waiter had taken it over to give us what he wanted us to eat, you see. And I told him, I said, well the boss said that to give us what we wanted to eat, see? And boy, we got to scuffling there and everything, see? And I got fired that night, see? Over this food deal. And that's when I was on my way going home with my drums. And that's when Bootsy Hernandez said, hey, ....
Yes. BUSY or something. And so Bootsy asked me he said, hey, man, where are you going with those drums? I said, I'm going home. He say, oh yes, he said, where have you been working?
I told him Tom's Road House, see? He said, well, why did you leave? I say, for fighting. And he said, bring me four pieces to the, I forget the name of it, the place, ....
Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?)
